baseMultiplierSource.label: Pinned PoE1 player critical multiplier rule: 150%; not a client GameConstants record.

ruleSource.label: Pinned PoE1 resistance profile: strongest exposure, floor -200, configured/default maximum, then penetration without a second floor.

operationOrder: select strongest enabled exposure without stacking
derive maximum from original raw resistance or explicit default75 mode
clamp exposed resistance to maximum and -200 floor
subtract summed penetration without another floor
apply same effective factor to noncritical and critical lightning hit damage
resistanceReference.exposureStateAssumption: enabled is an explicitly already-active configured snapshot state; application timing, chance, duration and uptime are not calculated
resistanceReference.legacyEffectiveProfile: exclusive caller-supplied already-effective resistance; no raw profile, exposure, penetration or inferred cap

shockReference.statInterpretation: matching canonical game vocabulary only; configured magnitude is scenario input, not a parsed item modifier or shock-effect scaling stat

ruleSource.label: Pinned PoE1 configured shock endpoint: increased damage taken, maximum 50%; host-supplied uptime weights explicit shocked and unshocked states.

shockReference.applicationAssumption: externally configured shock state independent of Spark damage, critical chance, chance to shock, duration, application threshold and hit/cast frequency; no inferred application feedback
shockReference.otherAilments: excluded; average mode keeps Cannot inflict Elemental Ailments to prohibit self-generated ailments while configured external shock remains explicit

fasterCastingReference.name: Faster Casting
fasterCastingReference.timingAssumption: Add this increased cast speed to applicable item cast speed before positive-rate validation and two-decimal speed-multiplier rounding; the active Spark base time remains 0.6s, no repeats/triggers/additional hits, capped at 1/0.033 casts per second.
fasterCastingReference.xmlScalarDomain: All five damage/cast item scalar lines require safe integer values; pinned PoB rounds fractional values per item line before the Speed sum. Direct canonical API decimals have separate arithmetic tests and are not claimed as identical XML imports.

conductivityReference.name: Conductivity

ruleSource.label: Pinned PoE1 already-active Conductivity: scale each curse stat, round to two decimals then truncate toward zero; add resistance reduction before caps and penetration.

conductivityReference.scaling: trunc(round(baseStat * (1 + increasedEffectPercent / 100), 2)); preserve raw scaled and rounded values before truncation
conductivityReference.applicationAssumption: one externally configured already-active nonboss normal Conductivity; no application cost/cast timing, duration/uptime inference, hexproof, curse-limit competition, bosses, other curses or generated shock; chance-to-be-shocked side stat retained and excluded under explicit Cannot inflict Elemental Ailments policy
